title: the metric tool records into its holder's recorder
intention: A metric tool at cairn/tools/metric/: Metric(holder_dir, charter_path, source).record(name, value, ...) writes into the holder's data recorder, refusing a name its charter does not declare with a consumer, and take(holder_dir, sink) hands what waits to a sink as rows in the one metrics table's shape.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: no cairn/tools/metric exists; outline 17.27 defines the metric primitive, and Akien answering Q#78 made the inference proxy's spent, saved and latency metrics read by the yield report (11.4.4.2).
how: A tool over the data recorder; a red-first proof over a scratch holder and charter.

clauses.claim: a declared name lands in <holder>/tools/data_recorder/metrics/ with its name, source, value, subject, info and the charter's unit, and metric.py imports no bus and no database
an undeclared name, and one declared with a blank consumer, raise UndeclaredMetric naming the name, and nothing is written
take hands the sink rows with exactly the COLUMNS keys and clears them only after the sink returns; a sink that raises leaves every record in place
after a write the recorder's reading.json declares an int read frequency and on_read drain

decisions.text: D1: cairn/tools/metric/metric.py as built from the chart: RECORDER='metrics'; READ_FREQUENCY_SECONDS=86400 labeled HYPOTHESIS; COLUMNS = at timestamptz NOT NULL, name text NOT NULL, source text NOT NULL, start timestamptz, end timestamptz, value double precision, unit text, subject text, info jsonb; class UndeclaredMetric(ValueError); recorder(holder_dir) -> DataRecorder(holder/tools/data_recorder/metrics, READ_FREQUENCY_SECONDS, on_read='drain'); declared(charter_path) reads the charter's 'metrics' map; class Metric(DiagnosticBase) with record(name, value=None, *, unit, subject, start, end, info, at) writing finding=name, inspector_target='metrics', probe_source=source and the rest, unit defaulting to the declared unit, refusing an undeclared or consumer-blank name before any write; take(holder_dir, sink) reads, calls sink(rows) with exactly COLUMNS keys, then stamp_read(ids) (drain clears). Imports only json, datetime, pathlib, cairn.tools.base.diagnostic and cairn.tools.data_recorder. cairn/tools/metric/__init__.py is empty.

D2: the charter cairn/tools/metric/intention+why.json, written through the artifact door (cairn artifact write, verb cast), node_class tool, public_interface cairn.tools.metric.metric, what/why/falsifier from outline 17.27 and Akien's Q#78 answer.

D3: the proof cairn/tools/metric/proofs/test_metric.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES 75de6bafbd95 1-4, over a scratch holder directory and a scratch charter declaring 'spent' (consumer the yield report, unit tokens) and 'orphan' (blank consumer). Tooth 1 also parses metric.py's imports with ast and refuses cairn.devices, psycopg2 and any bus module.

D4: D2's charter content, whole: component metric, runtime_role tool, node_class tool, public_interface [cairn.tools.metric.metric], invoke 'from cairn.tools.metric.metric import Metric, take, COLUMNS, UndeclaredMetric; prove with python3 cairn/tools/metric/proofs/test_metric.py'. what: Metric(holder_dir, charter_path, source).record(name, value, unit, subject, start, end, info, at) writes one record into <holder>/tools/data_recorder/metrics/, no bus and no database; a name the recording component's charter does not declare under metrics {name: {consumer, unit}} raises UndeclaredMetric and writes nothing; take(holder_dir, sink) hands sink rows with exactly COLUMNS and clears them only after it returns. why (Akien 2026-11-09, outline 17.27): 'a metric is a primitive; its job is to measure whatever it is, and like feedback it must eventually have a consumer'; his Q#78 answer made the inference proxy's spent, saved and latency metrics, read by the yield report (11.4.4.2). falsifier: the four clauses of this ticket. owner: a tool has users, not an owner (Law 6). how_it_learns and learns: it does not; it records. The JSON stands in the scratch file the build passes to cairn artifact write --from.

out: the metrics table and its report verb (the cairn device, next ticket)
